checkpoints.why: needs your organisation's signing secret and your request path
runs client-side inside your own agent

deny_codes.means: a cited token's signature did not verify
a cited token resolved to different content than claimed
a cited reading has drifted past its band's threshold
a cited address falls in an operator-restricted zone
a sentence states a figure that disagrees with the fact it cites
a measurable claim about a place carried no citation
a loaded detection module denied; the module id and version are in the verdict and the log

evidence_here.receipt: every hosted verdict carries an ed25519 receipt over the fact cids it read

fixes.action: the citation cannot be made to verify; drop it
a person restricted this, not the evidence
resolve the observation through emem and cite the token
remove the offending span and retry; the request itself is fine
restate the figure as the cited fact reports it, or cite the fact that says what you wrote

never_denies_on: a citation this node does not hold. It is indistinguishable from one minted by another responder.

not_served_here./log/entries: this responder keeps no verdict log; a node you run does
not_served_here./log/entry/{leaf}: this responder keeps no verdict log; a node you run does
not_served_here./log/head: this responder keeps no verdict log; a node you run does
not_served_here./modules: this responder loads no detection modules and will not

resolver: this responder's own corpus, read directly
what_it_checks: whether cited observations verify, and whether measurable claims about the physical world carry a citation
what_it_does_not_check: content safety, personal data, secrets. Load a module on a node you run.
